## Outcome

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the actual issue using a closing keyword when this PR completes it.

## Verification

| Check | Result and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Relevant tests | Record the executed command and observed result |
| Native behavior | Link the actual object, source ref or read-back |
| Rendered content | Verify affected file/comment/Wiki/release surfaces when changed |

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied or remaining work is explicitly linked.

## Limits and reviewer focus

State meaningful remaining risks and decisions here. Keep required information visible. Use a collapsed section for lengthy secondary logs when useful.
